content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works (photo, licence-plate phone number, hours), but the page repeats the full address/hours/directions block three times and the plate-styled prices read oddly as registration numbers.","desktopNote":"The hero is strong and trade-specific, yet lower sections collapse into the left half: the towing section is a near-empty band with a lone 'Gorenjska' row, the process list hugs the left column, and service text is small for the width.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Merge the three address/hours/directions blocks (blue band under hero, blue 'Pokličite nas' section, footer) into one contact section plus a minimal footer.","Fill the right half of the desktop towing and process sections (map of Gorenjska, a photo, or a two-column layout) and widen the service grid typography to remove the dead bands.","Reserve the licence-plate styling for the phone number only; show prices as plain large figures so the motif stays meaningful."],"blockers":["Desktop, 'Vlečna služba' section: right column is essentially empty apart from a stray 'Gorenjska' line under a rule, leaving a large dead band.","Phone and desktop: address, opening hours and 'Navodila za pot' are repeated in three separate sections (hero band, call-to-action block, footer)."]}
